# Script tables: native-speaker review

*Generated by `scripts/export_script_review.py`; do not edit the tables by hand. Tick each box when checked and write fixes in the notes; fixes go into `src/akshara/core/script.py` or the build scripts.*

These tables decide which mistakes are planted in the benchmark and, later, which alternatives the per-word sound check compares against. Nothing here was learned from data: features come from the traditional letter grid, look-alikes from rendered glyphs (`scripts/build_glyph_table.py`, three fonts per script). That is why a native check is required before results built on them are published.

Mistake types and how they are scored:

| Type | Family | Should be flagged | "Not sure" acceptable | Audible when synthesised |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| skip | word | yes | no | yes |
| distant | word | yes | no | yes |
| half | word | yes | no | yes |
| first_guess | word | yes | no | yes |
| reversal | word | yes | no | yes |
| near | word | yes | yes | yes |
| visual | word | yes | yes | yes |
| matra | word | yes | yes | yes |
| conjunct | word | yes | yes | yes |
| vowel_length | word | yes | yes | check |
| repeat | fluency | no | no | yes |
| selfcorrect | fluency | no | no | yes |
| decode | fluency | no | no | yes |
| hesitation | fluency | no | no | yes |
